description: This file implements the Time class and related functions for handling date and time operations, including parsing various date formats, conversions between local and UTC time, and generating string representations in different formats. It also includes platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class for handling date and time operations, including parsing, formatting, conversions, and platform-specific time management.

methods.name: IsLeapYear
methods.description: Checks if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: SkipLeadingSpaces
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in a buffer.

methods.name: WeekFromName
methods.description: Returns the weekday index from the full weekday name.

methods.name: WeekFromAbbrevation
methods.description: Returns the weekday index from the abbreviated weekday name.

methods.name: WeekFromString
methods.description: Parses a weekday string and returns the index.

methods.name: MonthFromString
methods.description: Returns the month index from a string.

methods.name: YearFromString
methods.description: Parses a year from a string.

methods.name: TimeFromString
methods.description: Parses time (hours, minutes, seconds) from a string.
